title: AROH Data Processing Register & Inventory
effective_framework: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 & DPDP Rules, 2025

entries.source: Directly provided by Data Principal during signup/login
entries.collection_point: Web Portal: /login, Firebase Auth Client SDK
entries.purpose: Account creation, identity authentication, role-based authorization, and account security
entries.legal_basis: Consent (DPDP Act Sec 6) and Certain Legitimate Uses (Sec 7)
entries.storage_system: Firebase Auth Database / In-Memory Mock Store in dev
entries.location: Global / Multi-region cloud infrastructure (US/Asia/EU depending on project tier)
entries.retention_period: Duration of active account lifecycle plus 30 days post-deletion grace period
entries.deletion_method: Hard programmatic purge via Firebase Admin Auth API
entries.logging: Authentication attempts logged with IP and timestamp; password hashes never logged
entries.sharing: None with third parties outside hosting and authentication processors
entries.international_transfer: Applicable (Google Cloud multi-region); subject to central government transfer rules

entries.source: Directly provided by Data Principal or set on initialization
entries.purpose: User personalisation, UI representation, and membership entitlement gating
entries.retention_period: Retained during active user account lifecycle; purged immediately upon account deletion
entries.deletion_method: Document deletion via Firestore Admin SDK
entries.logging: Profile update events logged for audit trail
entries.international_transfer: Applicable depending on GCP deployment region

entries.purpose: Maintenance of immutable Aros token ledger, fraud detection, and entitlement verification
entries.legal_basis: Certain Legitimate Uses (Sec 7) and Contractual Fulfillment
entries.processor: Google Cloud Firestore / Local In-Memory Mock Ledger
entries.retention_period: 7 years for financial ledger entries pursuant to applicable Indian accounting/tax regulations; pseudonymized on account deletion
entries.deletion_method: Pseudonymization on user deletion; transaction record retained without direct PII reference
entries.logging: All balance mutations strictly auditable with transactional integrity
entries.sharing: None, except statutory financial reporting if legally mandated
entries.international_transfer: Applicable depending on GCP deployment region
entries.user_right: Access, correction of erroneous entries via grievance officer

entries.source: User interactive input in AI portal or developer API invocation
entries.collection_point: Web Portal: /ai, ASDK AI Orchestrator API
entries.purpose: Executing stateless developer assistance, code explanation, and conversational generation
entries.processor: MockAIProvider (in dev) / Configurable LLM Providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini when configured)
entries.storage_system: Stateless execution; no persistent server-side prompt storage without user consent
entries.location: External AI Provider data centers (US/EU) when third-party provider enabled
entries.retention_period: Zero persistent storage in AROH core; ephemeral in-memory session only
entries.deletion_method: Instant garbage collection upon HTTP response completion
entries.logging: Aggregated token count and model latency only; raw prompt text redacted from operational logs
entries.sharing: Sent only to chosen AI model provider during explicit user request
entries.international_transfer: Applicable if third-party non-domestic LLM API is configured
entries.user_right: Erasure, consent withdrawal, right to know third-party model processor

entries.source: Automated network ingress during web requests
entries.collection_point: Next.js Edge / Node.js Middleware, Vercel Edge Ingress
entries.purpose: System availability, network security, rate limiting, and DDoS defense
entries.legal_basis: Certain Legitimate Uses (DPDP Act Sec 7) & System Integrity
entries.location: Global Edge PoPs / US Data Centers
entries.deletion_method: Automated TTL expiration and log rotation
entries.logging: Diagnostic access logs; IP addresses anonymized/truncated in analytics views
entries.user_right: Right to information regarding technical processing safeguards

entries.source: User interaction with Cookie Banner and Privacy Settings
entries.purpose: Proving lawful affirmative consent and managing preference enforcement under DPDP Rules 2025
entries.storage_system: Client LocalStorage / Browser Cookie & Server Audit Store
entries.retention_period: Duration of user account plus statutory limitation period for compliance audit (3 years)
entries.deletion_method: Cryptographically anonymized upon account deletion; timestamp retained for aggregate audit
entries.logging: Consent creation, modification, and withdrawal events strictly logged
entries.sharing: Available to Data Protection Board of India upon lawful regulatory audit
entries.international_transfer: Subject to central server storage region
entries.user_right: Access, inspection of recorded affirmative consent, withdrawal

entries.source: Submitted by Data Principal or legal representative
entries.purpose: Redressal of grievances and fulfilment of statutory Data Principal rights within prescribed timelines (max 90 days)
entries.retention_period: 3 years from resolution date to satisfy regulatory audit requirements
entries.deletion_method: Hard delete after 3-year statutory audit expiry
entries.logging: Every status change and officer note timestamped in tamper-evident audit trail
entries.sharing: Data Protection Board of India in event of regulatory appeal/investigation
entries.user_right: Access, correction of submission, withdrawal of complaint
